Tracklist:

 1. Overture - Orchestra

14. Bianca - Harold Lang

16. Brush Up Your Shakespeare - Aloysius Donovan; Alexis Dubroff
17. I Am Ashamed That Women Are So Simple - Patricia Morison
18. Finale (so Kiss Me, Kate) - Alfred Drake; Patricia Morison and Chorus
